Rule.Description: Flags a template whose top-level Metadata has no Metadata.com.aws.cloudformation.Context block, and significant resources missing a Metadata.com.aws.cloudformation.Context block. Rationale written as YAML comments is not visible to cfn-lint; disable this rule (ignore_checks W4010) on templates that document context that way or do not adopt the Context convention.
